title: Contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN — Bratislava & Vienna
description: Phone numbers in Bratislava and Vienna, e-mail and enquiry form. Free consultation on interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.

parts.html: Call us, message us on Telegram or WhatsApp, or submit a request through the form — we will reply within one business day.
The studio is in Bratislava, at Súkennícka 1 in the Ružinov district. Visit us by appointment: we’ll show you material and hardware samples and talk through your project.
In Vienna we meet on site: measurements, consultations, and design supervision work there just as they do in Bratislava. The first consultation is free.

In your request, tell us the city, the floor area, and what you need: a design project, furniture, a kitchen, or a renovation. If you have a floor plan from the developer, send it to us via messenger so the consultation can focus on specifics.
